status: frozen goals before actor implementation; not executed

authorship.note: Assessor shares approved contract and repository context; goals are not a predetermined successful transcript. Implementation authors may read this file, so do not label eventual execution blind.

execution_policy.surface: actual installed launcher plus independent validated checkpoint/receipt inspection
execution_policy.adaptive: Inspect public availability and permission before choosing each action. Select only admitted commands; record branches, refusals and unsupported observations. Never patch runtime constants or invent missing capabilities to achieve a goal.
execution_policy.success_basis: material states, provenance, authority and durable chronological outcomes; never scenario-complete flags
execution_policy.clock: Compare committed WORLD-1 positions and unique interval identities against admitted physical/wait intervals, not number of command lines. Zero-time observations/requests do not tick.
execution_policy.privacy: Public assertions must be justified by the receiving actor's admitted evidence or communication. Developer inspection may establish truth but must never supply player/actor decisions.
execution_policy.frozen_scope: Concrete command/API bindings may be supplied later without weakening goals. Any semantic goal change requires a recorded revision.

shared_forbidden_outcomes: Acceptance transfers tools or reserves supplies without an owner transition.
NPC physical steps recursively advance the world clock.
One actor performs preparation and work as two physical steps in one interval.
Player absence freezes otherwise due work or grants remote live knowledge.
A rejected player physical attempt advances NPC work.
A role or household relationship substitutes for consent or access.
A failed unacknowledged interval leaks partially committed actor/environment history.

journeys.title: Voluntary work while absent and one shared clock
journeys.initial_goal: Have a willing actor clean a real dirty surface while preserving consent, performer custody and truthful last-communicated status.
initial_conditions: Two actor profiles and a finite dirty target are declared.
At least one method requires a preparation step; public communication route and tool permission are known.
action_strategy: Observe local actor availability; branch to an admitted willing actor or record a truthful refusal.
Request explicit method; verify acceptance alone does not alter materials/time. Attempt an incompatible second request to a busy actor.
If supplies are unavailable, lawfully supply or release a qualified tool; never assume acceptance reserves it.
Leave by admitted route; advance bounded time elsewhere; compare 0/1/2 due-actor variants.
Inspect agreement remotely, then return and inspect the actual surface and inquire locally.
objective_predicates: Acceptance has performer/requester attribution and zero contributed physical steps.
Each world interval advances exactly once with 0, 1 or 2 due NPCs; at most one physical step per actor.
Material residues move conservatively into actual tool/bath/deposit compartments; real work can continue absent player.
Remote agreement stays last communicated; local report matches performer history without granting hidden third-party knowledge.
forbidden_outcomes: Borrow player-held tool, player light or remote senses.
Busy actor silently queues a second job.
restart_points: After acceptance before first eligible interval.

journeys.title: Contested tools and cooperative assembly
journeys.initial_goal: Resolve finite tool/fastener competition and finish one reversible assembly through correctly attributed steps.
initial_conditions: Two actors can pursue a declared assembly or cleaning goal.
One contested tool/fastener is actually accessible under explicit permission; no reservation exists.
action_strategy: Observe who can lawfully reach the resource. Request compatible explicit goals from willing actors.
Advance one interval; inspect which actual owner transition acquired/used the resource.
In reversed actor-order profile, repeat from equivalent qualified root.
Include a player-first contention variant; release or supply an admitted alternative only after observing the block.
Cooperate on missing assembly steps; selectively recover connections through admitted actor or player methods.
objective_predicates: Stable declared order changes contested outcomes where appropriate; no duplicate custody/use or stale stock.
Losing actor blocks without same-tick replacement action.
Support placement and fastening are separate physical contributions attributed to actual performers.
Recovery preserves component identities and finite fastener allocation; task counters do not stand in for assembly state.
forbidden_outcomes: Same tool carried by two actors.
Actor retrieves, walks and fastens in one interval.
Player cancellation controls standing work without actor decision.
restart_points: Immediately after contention winner acquires resource.

journeys.title: Blocked-due withdrawal boundaries
journeys.initial_goal: Show consent withdrawal and K blocked-due accounting at exact boundaries without fabricated work or resurrection.
initial_conditions: An accepted task can remain genuinely blocked by a finite unavailable resource.
Immutable profile supplies K; default 3 plus one nondefault positive K variant.
action_strategy: Accept locally, remove opportunity lawfully, then advance to K-1 actually due blocked intervals.
Interleave zero-time inspection, repeated refused requests, and a paused/not-yet-due interval where admitted.
Restart, advance through K, restart again and advance to K+1.
In a separate branch restore opportunity before K and verify one successful preparation resets the blocked count.
In another branch invalidate consent before a due interval; later request fresh participation rather than resume withdrawn identity.
objective_predicates: No withdrawal at K-1; withdrawal at Kth blocked due boundary; no old-task contribution at K+1.
Only actually due committed blocked intervals increment; successful physical preparation/contribution resets.
Paused, zero-time and technical-retry events do not increment.
Consent invalidation prevents the next physical transition.
Withdrawal preserves tools, prior material changes and historical contributions; fresh consent never duplicates them.
forbidden_outcomes: Timeout returns tools or updates remote player status automatically.
Withdrawn task immediately replaced by standing work in the same interval.

journeys.title: Evidence symmetry, stale reports and externally satisfied work
journeys.initial_goal: Distinguish physical truth, performer knowledge, player evidence and communicated claims under changing visibility.
initial_conditions: One observable work event and one hidden/closed or dark event can be arranged lawfully.
Actors and player have individually declared sensing/communication opportunities.
action_strategy: Observe one NPC step with player present and qualified; repeat with player absent or unqualified.
Have an NPC witness a declared event and compare that actor's evidence with a differently situated observer.
Communicate an admitted false/stale claim; change the actual target afterward without that recipient observing it.
Ask locally later; require source-qualified historical answer or unknown/unsupported.
While a task owner lacks observation, satisfy its material goal through another performer. Revalidate before and after lawful discovery.
objective_predicates: Witness admission uses same actor-generic mechanism for player/NPC with actor-specific results.
Reported assertion records speaker/source; changes no object placement or first-hand knowledge.
Stale answers do not silently refresh from current backend truth.
Externally satisfied goal grants no false contribution; awareness/reporting occurs only after qualified discovery.
Offscreen activity and hidden Pin Blank/sealed/private facts never appear through public status or provenance.
forbidden_outcomes: Exact event dating or culprit inferred from generic trace.
Player reads NPC private witness store.
Goal predicate telepathically informs actor or requester.
restart_points: After stale report before hidden physical change.
Between external satisfaction and actor discovery.

journeys.title: Durable prefix and neutral configuration transfer
journeys.initial_goal: Preserve exactly the acknowledged mixed-owner prefix across restart and faults, with equivalent neutral identities/configuration-only profiles.
initial_conditions: Equivalent configuration-declared roots provide neutral actors, locations and objects without stock Tarrow IDs.
Supported fault harness can fail before/around atomic replacement and after an acknowledged interval; it does not alter domain decisions.
action_strategy: Run an admitted mixed player/NPC duration crossing an exposure condition boundary.
Record each public durable acknowledgement and independent receipt chain.
Inject persistence failure at selected boundary; stop mutation and restart from validated checkpoint.
Repeat batched versus single intervals with extra zero-time observations.
Repeat using neutral identities/topology and two declared priority/participation variants; compare semantic outcomes after identity normalization, not raw ID equality.
objective_predicates: 0/1/2 NPC variants retain one clock advancement per interval.
After fault, state equals the validated acknowledged prefix, with no partial actor/environment/material/evidence changes.
Restart/retry does not repeat contributions, observations, drying or withdrawals.
All admitted rules/profile semantics survive neutral transfer without runtime-code edits.
Batch/single progression agrees through condition boundary and restart when circumstances agree.
forbidden_outcomes: Trusted forged final state replaces replay.
Fault testing conceals unresolved atomic-replacement uncertainty.
Neutral test obtains success by monkeypatching actor IDs in constants.
restart_points: After acknowledged first interval before later failure.

coverage_selection.included: Target all mandatory boundary axes directly; combine compatible ordinary cases in journeys rather than a full Cartesian product. Every selected variant repeats twice.
deliberate_omissions: No native timetable, invented physiology or East Gate repair.
No full Cartesian product of every method/order/light/restart/fault combination.
No claim that these goals alone replace contract tests or six effective mutation classes.
residual_risks: API binding may reveal unavailable fixture opportunity; report gaps instead of weakening predicates.
Independent assessor goals are visible to implementers, so they test transfer of goals but are not blind acceptance.
Human usability and native content validation remain separate gates.
